test.author: Christoph Deppisch
test.name: FinallyBlockIT
test.description:
Sometimes it is important to do finishing work when a test case failes. For instance it might be necessary to clean up the database. These actions have to be executed in any case, even if the test chain breaks due to errors.
Therefore a test case offers a finalActions besides the testActions. The actions in this finally chain will be executed after the test, even in case off errors.
In the example below the first action creates an order in the database. Then some more actions might follow. Here it is a simple TraceVariablesAction. But there can be errors in these actions. To be sure that the order in the database is deleted after the test, the finalActions contains the respective action. This action will be executed even in case of errors in the testActions above.

statements.statement: INSERT INTO ORDERS (ORDER_ID, REQUEST_TAG, CONVERSATION_ID, CREATION_DATE) VALUES (${orderId},1,1,'citrus:currentDate(dd.MM.yyyy)')
